code:
import os, subprocess, tempfile, hashlib, pathlib

GIT_ENV = dict(os.environ)
for _k, _v in [("GIT_AUTHOR_NAME", "dev"), ("GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL", "dev@example.com"),
               ("GIT_AUTHOR_DATE", "2026-01-01T00:00:00+00:00"),
               ("GIT_COMMITTER_NAME", "dev"), ("GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL", "dev@example.com"),
               ("GIT_COMMITTER_DATE", "2026-01-01T00:00:00+00:00")]:
    GIT_ENV[_k] = _v

def g(args, cwd):
    r = subprocess.run(["git"] + args, cwd=cwd, capture_output=True, text=True, env=GIT_ENV)
    if r.returncode != 0:
        raise RuntimeError("git %s failed:\n%s" % (args, r.stderr))
    return r.stdout

def new_repo():
    d = tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="repo_")
    g(["init", "-q", "-b", "main"], d)
    g(["config", "user.name", "dev"], d)
    g(["config", "user.email", "dev@example.com"], d)
    g(["config", "commit.gpgsign", "false"], d)
    g(["config", "core.autocrlf", "false"], d)
    g(["config", "core.eol", "lf"], d)
    return d

def w(d, name, content):
    p = pathlib.Path(d) / name
    if isinstance(content, str):
        p.write_bytes(content.encode("utf-8"))
    else:
        p.write_bytes(content)

def blob_sha(content_bytes):
    b = content_bytes.encode("utf-8") if isinstance(content_bytes, str) else content_bytes
    h = hashlib.sha1()
    h.update(b"blob " + str(len(b)).encode() + b"\x00" + b)
    return h.hexdigest()


d = new_repo()
w(d, "f.txt", "base line\n")
g(["add", "-A"], d)
g(["commit", "-q", "-m", "base"], d)
g(["branch", "feature"], d)
w(d, "f.txt", "main changed\n")
g(["add", "-A"], d)
g(["commit", "-q", "-m", "main-work"], d)
g(["checkout", "-q", "feature"], d)
w(d, "f.txt", "feature changed\n")
g(["add", "-A"], d)
g(["commit", "-q", "-m", "feature-work"], d)
g(["checkout", "-q", "main"], d)
rc = subprocess.run(["git", "merge", "--no-ff", "-m", "merge", "feature"],
                    cwd=d, capture_output=True, text=True, env=GIT_ENV)
status = g(["status", "--porcelain"], d).strip()
content = (pathlib.Path(d) / "f.txt").read_text()
print("冲突的产生与解决")
print("  merge 返回码(非0表示有冲突): " + str(rc.returncode))
print("  git status --porcelain 中含冲突标记 UU: " + str("UU" in status))
print("  冲突文件 f.txt 含 <<<<<<< 标记: " + str("<<<<<<<" in content))
(pathlib.Path(d) / "f.txt").write_bytes(b"main changed\n")
g(["add", "f.txt"], d)
g(["commit", "-q", "-m", "resolve"], d)
np = g(["rev-list", "--parents", "-n", "1", "HEAD"], d).split()
print("  解决并提交后 merge commit 的 parent 数: " + str(len(np) - 1))
print("  HEAD 现指向 merge commit: " + g(["rev-parse", "HEAD"], d).strip()[:7])
print("结论: 同一区域相对 base 都被修改且结果不同才冲突；冲突标记 <<<<<<< 须手动消除后再提交")
